This application coming on for conciliation this day, the  2  Bench passed the following:
 ORDER
This is an application for restoration of Miscellaneous Appeal No.1354 of 2022 arising out of compensation under Motor Vehicles Act, 1988.

The appeal has been dismissed on account of non-compliance of peremptory order / common conditional order because the requisite court fee Prabhulal vs Manjunath on 13 May, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/90847328/
1 could not be deposited within the stipulated period.

entities.text: Prabhulal vs Manjunath on 13 May, 2023 Indian Kanoon
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Counsel for the applicant informs that the requisite court fee could not be deposited within the stipulated time and there is a delay also because the applicant could not arrange the fund for requisite court fee.
Considering the aforesaid, the application is allowed and MA No.1354 of 2022 is restored to its original number.
As a consequence, delay in filing the restoration application is also condoned.
Accordingly, MCC stands allowed and disposed of.
